unit: WF4 Distil Sources registry provenance, content alignment and heading-anchored excerpting
description: THE EXECUTION 335 SHAPE: a large Act whose first 6000 characters are front matter and contents, so the old text.slice(0, 6000) stored a contents page. The anchored excerpt must reach the provision instead.
why_it_exists: Execution 335: the stored excerpt was text.slice(0, 6000), which on a consolidated Act is the cover page and the table of contents. All four sources were graded RETRIEVED and handed to the drafter as four contents listings, while research_status read COMPLETE and source_ref_count satisfied the Approval Gate unsourced-law check. A draft could therefore assert s 13 of the Limitation Act having never been shown the text of s 13: right provenance, right citation, wrong content. Execution 340: the pinpoint was harvested from the excerpt window, so it named cross-references INSIDE the provision ("section 88; Division 2; Division 3; section 7" for a row whose source is s 13) and was blank for the Road Traffic row, whose window writes "Section 54" with a capital S that the cross-reference regex does not match. The pinpoint is now the section number captured by the heading anchor; cross-references are still reported, under their own name.
